notes.title: Mirth Melody Version 1.1
notes.content:
Greetings, Mirth folks!

The latest update for Mirth Melody is finally here! We've done our best to address the issues posted on the discussion forum. Here are the changes:

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added French localization by Miel/M.E
[*] Added a glyph icon and instruction for throwing items
[*] Added a new option for changing screen resolution
[*] Added a new option to enable/disable full-screen mode
[*] Added a new option for adjusting graphic quality
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized shaders for better performance
[*] Slightly improved optimization in the forest scene
[*] Updated some note timings to better sync with the music
[*] Fixed a bug causing the menu to become unresponsive when quitting during the rhythm game
[/list]
[h3]Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] If you're having difficulty pressing 3 buttons simultaneously, it might be due to a limitation of your keyboard hardware. Since this is a hardware issue, we won’t include 3 simultaneous notes in future updates.
[/list]

If you encounter any further issues, please post them on the discussion forum.

Thank you for your continued support, and see you next time!

Best regards,
Clay Game Studio
